mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.3pp in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real GDP signals a weakening demand environment, which reduces corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods following a 3-month decline in GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within the last month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and retail sales by more than 2% within the last month signals a strengthening consumer demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS increase > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by more than 2% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2 percentage points within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2pp in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and increases corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreased by more than 0.25% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the consumer price index signals rising inflationary pressures, which erodes consumer purchasing power and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods following a 3-month increase in CPIAUCSL.
